title: Reading Drill — A trial of reusable name badges — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: A trial of reusable name badges — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The event coordinator in Foxhaven received an old report about badges being thrown away when an event ends. The report compared badge return rate, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the check-in records rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered six weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include different closing times. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a collection point near the exit as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
